breaking: duration removed: the count follows the scroll position (view() timeline, entry 0% .. cover 25%)
once removed: a scroll-linked count runs back when the block scrolls out
threshold removed: the range is fixed to entry 0% .. cover 25%
negative numbers, exponent notation and non-3-digit grouping show the final value without counting
